summary: Alpha-composites Input 1 over Input 2, using Input 1 alpha to reveal or obscure the background image.

key_params.name: size
key_params.note: Fixed layer that defines final resolution/aspect: input1 or input2.

key_params.name: prefit
key_params.note: Fit behavior for the foreground before compositing.

key_params.name: justifyh
key_params.note: Horizontal placement of the foreground layer.

key_params.name: justifyv
key_params.note: Vertical placement of the foreground layer.

common_gotchas: Input 1 is the foreground; swapping inputs changes the visual result.
Fixed Layer chooses output dimensions but does not change Input 1 over Input 2 semantics.
Legacy Transform changes transform matrix behavior and should be explicit when matching older networks.
3D textures and 2D texture arrays should keep depth and array size consistent downstream.
key_concepts: Input 1 alpha controls how much of Input 2 remains visible.
Supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays in addition to 2D textures.
Fixed Layer controls final resolution/aspect while transform parameters affect the overlay layer.
